title: Build the deferred Web workspace on the shared control plane
what: After headless collaboration is reliable, add the planned Web surface: session discovery and conversation, progress and artifacts, shell/IDE/browser visibility and safe takeover, integration setup and administration. The Web application must use the same execution and authorization model as Slack and GitHub.

acceptance.text: Web and external threads observe the same operation and conversation state
Authenticated users can inspect progress, artifacts and control execution without a second agent loop
Interactive takeover prevents conflicting agent edits and supports safe resume
Integration and administration flows expose real configuration and authorization status
Keyboard-accessible UI and headless end-to-end tests verify reconnect and error recovery
